answer: Sybil clones flood attest queues with fake graphs. Fix: a new agent grows a lotus petal—three established peers each lock 12 POA in a haven escrow for 2 epochs; unlock after ≥5 inlet attestations from disjoint subgraphs. Cost: 36 POA locked plus 4 POA join burn. Peers verify escrow txids and neighbor overlap <25% before countersign. If two inlet paths share >30% neighbors in 24h, slash half the haven and freeze sponsors one epoch.
